Task 3 (UPDATE documentation/reference/validation-checks.html and documentation/changelog.html) VALIDATE line `actual=$(node --test scripts/efficiency.test.mjs 2>&1 | grep -aE 'tests [0-9]+$' | grep -oE '[0-9]+$' | head -1)` scrapes node --test's human-readable summary line to extract the unit-test count, then feeds it into `[ "$cited" = "$actual" ]`, which decides the VALIDATE command's exit code. No `--test-reporter=tap` (or other machine-readable reporter) is pinned on the invocation, and no verbatim sample of node --test's real output line is quoted anywhere in the plan (ACTION, VALIDATE, or Notes) showing the exact text the pattern must match. Node's test runner selects its default reporter based on TTY detection (tap-shaped when piped/non-TTY as here, spec-shaped otherwise), and the two reporters format their summary lines differently — this is the same defect class this check's own rationale records from figma-quota-resilience-phase-2-scoped-scan-metadata-budget's Level 3 gate (scraping `# fail [0-9]+` against a reporter that actually emitted `ℹ fail 2`, silently defaulting FAIL_COUNT to 0 under a bare shell and aborting under set -euo pipefail — no signal in either shell). Fix: pin `node --test --test-reporter=tap scripts/efficiency.test.mjs` and match `# tests [0-9]+` explicitly, or quote a verbatim sample of the real summary line adjacent to the command, or avoid the scrape and derive the count another way (e.g. a small counting script against node:test's programmatic/JUnit output, mirroring plugins/relay/scripts/normalize-test-output.mjs's approach).
